name: Dots Studio (particle shapes, dot UI, physics, timeline)
summary: Original vanilla Dots Studio at /dots: 90 procedural shapes (polygons, stars, superformula, lissajous, roses, hearts, 3D projections, icons) + text/SVG/image sampling, staggered eased morphs, spring/gravity/pointer/collisions-lite physics, dots-rendered UI controls, palettes/dataset gradients, audio-reactive mode, timeline editor. Feature set catalogued from public dotsui.dev pages; no Pro/Studio code, artwork or shape data used.
snap: open /dots; modules public/dots/{shapes,morph,physics,scene,ui,render}.js are UMD (require() in Node, window.Dots* in browser)
